source: Zhang et al. (2024), results of RQ1.xlsx
snippet: whole method generate_world_map, lines 811 and 812 of the original
trigger: NOFF=3 (three nested for clauses); NOC=123 and NOO=22 also reach the threshold.
removed_from_original: all the rest of the file: outside the snippet; GameData reads game_data.json from disk when the module is imported, and the original World.__init__ creates the player, enemies and treasure, which the snippet does not use.
scaffolding: Minimal Location: coordinates x, y, z and the location tuple (the original Location derives from Node and also generates terrain, monsters and an item dict, which the snippet does not use).
Minimal World: the three sizes come from the arguments (the original fixes them at 10) and __init__ calls generate_world_map.

run(size_x, size_y, size_z): builds the World and returns the coordinates of every cell grouped by x and then by y, with loops (a comprehension of the same shape would put the smell in the scaffolding).
pinned_behavior: typical: a 2 x 2 x 3 map has one cell per coordinate, grouped by x and then by y.
edge: a one-cell map; a zero size on any axis gives empty groups at that level.
invalid: a size that is not an integer raises TypeError.
not_pinned_on_purpose: get_location of the original is not in the unit: it is the snippet of MNC-19 (chain of three indices) and the snippet does not call it.
